chapters.title: Fenwick tree over prefix sums
chapters.code:
def count_range_sum(nums, lower, upper):
    P = [0] + list(accumulate(nums))
    vals = sorted(set(P))
    tree = [0] * (len(vals) + 1)

    def add(i):
        while i < len(tree):
            tree[i] += 1
            i += i & -i

    def prefix(i):
        s = 0
        while i > 0:
            s += tree[i]
            i -= i & -i
        return s

    count = 0
    for p in P:
        lo = bisect.bisect_left(vals, p - upper)       # ranks before the window
        hi = bisect.bisect_right(vals, p - lower)      # ranks up to window end
        count += prefix(hi) - prefix(lo)
        add(bisect.bisect_left(vals, p) + 1)
    return count
